edges.label: same_fact
edges.reason: The EXISTING statement (Reuters) is the primary source of the information mentioned in the NEW statement (Al Jazeera), which explicitly says the officials told the Reuters news agency. The values are equivalent.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, Reuters reported “European countries would release 50 million barrels of diesel”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “Officials with knowledge of the meeting told the Reuters news agency that EU leaders discussed a proposal put forward by France, under which European countries would release 50 million barrels of diesel and International Energy Agency members would release 50 million barrels of crude oil.”.
